svg.text: Given everything in Ch 8, how do nodes agree?
Alice: "it's over!" Bob refreshes after hearing her
Linearizable: once ANY reader sees the new value, all later reads must too
Linearizability means every operation appears to take effect
atomically at one point in time, consistent with real-time order.
If the resizer reads a lagging storage replica, it resizes the
old image. Two channels give a race.

Else, when there is no partition, you trade Latency vs
Order: compare counter, tie-break by node ID → a TOTAL order consistent with causality
The limit: the order is only known after the fact.
If coordinator dies after PREPARE → participants stuck "in doubt", holding locks
The weakness is that 2PC blocks. If the coordinator dies,
participants hold locks until it recovers. This is why
entry committed once a MAJORITY (3/5) has it
If the leader goes silent, a follower times out, increments the
term, and asks for votes. A majority makes it leader. A higher
Membership via ephemeral nodes that vanish when a session
dies; config and shard maps that clients watch for changes.
Answer per feature: booking and payment are CP, search and feeds are AP. Mention PACELC latency cost.
Not 2PC (blocking, coupling). Use a saga + outbox + idempotent consumers.
Leader election via ZooKeeper or etcd (consensus), lease + fencing token.
